cases.imageAlt: 暗影裁缝的致命华尔兹
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
SUBJECTS:
Characters: A female haute couture tailor with an extremely lean and capable figure, arm muscle lines like steel wires, eyes cold and sharp as needle tips.
Clothing: A dark tactical vest incorporating cheongsam elements, bare arms, forearms wrapped with dark red silk wristbands (used to increase friction); slender fingers with metal fingertip guards.
Action Style: Integrating the inch-power of "Wing Chun" and the circular transitions of "Tai Chi". The movements follow a rhythm of (charging power -> extremely fast strike -> instant stillness), emphasizing the explosive power of the fingers and the tension of silk in the air.

ENVIRONMENT:
A dimly lit high-end private studio. The background is a wall-to-wall mahogany spool rack, with tens of thousands of color blocks forming a geometric aesthetic; in the center is a huge black marble cutting table with a mirror-like surface. A single-point focused industrial cold light hangs above, with tiny fiber particles floating in the air.

MOOD:
Extremely focused, chilling, gorgeous with a sense of ritual; movements as precise as a surgeon's, visually highly oppressive.

TIMELINE:
0:00-0:02: Close-up/Wide-angle POV. The tailor rests both hands on the black marble tabletop, head lowered and still. The camera rushes forward extremely fast, she suddenly looks up, eyes locking onto the camera (killer gaze). Her right hand grabs in the void, a bolt of dark purple heavy silk slides across the tabletop like a long snake, "locked" by her single hand.

0:02-0:05: Cut switch/Handheld feel. The tailor throws the satin into the air. Her figure is like an afterimage, holding a silver long scissors in her right hand, performing a "blind cut" the moment the satin falls. It is not ordinary cutting, but accompanied by the force of martial arts punching, the scissors slice through the air making a "hiss" sound of breaking the air, the fabric's cut is extremely neat, without the slightest mess.

0:05-0:07: Moving camera. She slides to the other end of the workbench with a side step. With a single horizontal sweep, several steel needles are shaken from the pincushion, suspended in mid-air. She pushes with applied force, the steel needles accurately sink into a distant hanger pattern like hidden weapons, the needle tails vibrate, emitting a metallic ringing sound.

0:07-0:10: Continuous shot. The tailor begins "thread control". She pulls out a gold thread, through the wrapping between her fingers, she controls the satin to automatically fold and take shape in the air like manipulating puppet strings. Every flick of her fingers is accompanied by spark-like static electricity. She hits the tabletop with her elbow, the presser foot bounces up, she instantly catches it and locks it dead onto the fabric.

0:10-0:12: Match cut. The tailor makes a sudden spin in place, the hem of her outer garment spreads out like a circular array. She brings her hands together, fiercely pulling the formed suit collar, the last gold thread draws a perfect arc in the air and automatically sews. The movement instantly cuts from extremely fast (afterimage) to extremely slow (freeze frame).

0:12-0:15: Stable POV. The dust settles. She lifts the finished dress with one hand, shakes it forcefully, the dress unfolds in front of the camera. The camera focuses on the exquisite embroidery on the collar. She lightly flicks the button with her fingernail—the button trembles. Then she turns and walks into the shadows, leaving a back view, the screen is completely covered by the rising mist of expensive perfume, cleanly fading out.

SUBJECTS (主体):
人物： 一位身形极度干练、手臂肌肉线条如钢丝般的女性高定裁缝，眼神冷冽如针尖。
着装： 融合了旗袍元素的深色战术马甲，双臂裸露，前臂缠绕着暗红色的丝绸护腕（用于增加摩擦力）；手指修长且指尖带有金属护具。 
动作风格： 融合了“咏春”的寸劲与“太极”的圆转。动作遵循（蓄力 → 极速出击 → 瞬间静止）的节奏，强调手指的爆发力和丝绸在空中的张力。

ENVIRONMENT (环境):
昏暗的高级私人工作室。背景是整面墙的红木线轴架，成千上万个色块形成几何美感；中心是一张巨大的黑色大理石裁剪台，表面光可鉴人。上方悬挂着单点聚焦的工业冷光灯，空气中漂浮着细微的纤维微粒。

MOOD (氛围):
极度专注、肃杀、带有仪式感的华丽；动作如外科医生般精确，视觉感官上极具压迫力。

TIMELINE (时间线):

cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Create a short video themed around a cat making handmade ramen in a late-night diner, cinematic color grading (warm tones, full of worldly atmosphere), fine grain, shallow depth of field.
The protagonist is a cat, playing the role of a professional ramen master, whose appearance strictly refers to [@[@Image 1]].
The scene is set in front of a late-night ramen stall full of Japanese style on a city street. The background features warm yellow lanterns, a wooden bar counter, and blurred street neon lights in the distance.
The video content needs to be displayed in the following storyboard steps:

Kneading and cutting dough: The cat wears a small apron, rhythmically kneading the dough on a wooden cutting board sprinkled with flour, and then using a sharp dough knife to cut the dough into even fine noodles.

Boiling and shaking dry: The cat scatters the noodles and throws them into a large boiling pot, a few seconds later uses a bamboo skimmer to scoop up the noodles, and skillfully and forcefully shakes them twice in the air to shake off the excess water.

Seasoning the soup base: The cat holds a delicate long-handled spoon, scoops out a spoonful of soup from the pot of richly simmered white bone broth, and slowly pours it into a large dark blue ceramic bowl.

Plating: The cat neatly puts the cooked noodles in with chopsticks, and then places two thick slices of chashu, half a soft-boiled egg, a few pieces of seaweed, and chopped green onions on top of the noodles in sequence, with delicate movements.

Ending: In the final shot, the cat master gently pushes this steaming bowl of ramen emitting white smoke towards the camera, and nods slightly as a gesture.

Requirements:

Video style: Realistic, clear picture, medium shot.

Sound (ASMR): The entire video does not require voice-over narration, but needs to amplify: the "da-da" sound when cutting noodles, the "hua-la" sound when noodles enter the water, the "sa-sa" sound when shaking off water, the flowing sound when hot soup enters the bowl, etc.

Background music: There is soft, soothing saxophone music in the background, creating a tranquil late-night atmosphere.

中文提示词:
制作一个以猫咪在深夜食堂制作手作拉面为主题的短视频，电影级调色（暖色调，充满烟火气），细腻颗粒，浅景深。
主角是一只猫咪，扮演一位专业拉面师傅，形象外观严格参照【@【@图1】】。
场景设定为城市街头一家充满和式风情的深夜拉面摊位前。背景有温暖的黄色灯笼、木质吧台，以及远处模糊的街道霓虹灯。
视频内容需要按照以下步骤分镜展示：

揉面与切面： 猫咪穿着小围裙，有节奏地在撒了面粉的木质案板上揉捏面团，然后用一把锋利的面刀将面团切成均匀的细面条。

煮面与甩干： 猫咪将面条抖散投入沸腾的大锅中，几秒后用竹漏勺将面条捞起，熟练地在空中用力甩两下，将多余的水分甩干。

调汤底： 猫咪拿着一个精致的长柄勺，从熬制浓郁的白色骨汤锅里舀出一勺汤，缓缓倒入一个深蓝色的陶瓷大碗中。

摆盘： 猫咪用筷子整齐地放入煮好的面条，再依次在面条上摆放两片厚实的叉烧、半个溏心蛋、几片海苔和葱花，动作精细。

结尾： 结尾镜头猫咪师傅将这碗热气腾腾、冒着白烟的拉面轻轻推向镜头，并微微点头示意。

要求：

视频风格： 写实，画面清晰，中景。

声音（ASMR）： 整个视频不需语音旁白，但要放大：切面时的“哒哒”声、面条入水的“哗啦”声、甩干水分的“飒飒”声、热汤入碗的流动声等。

背景音乐： 背景有轻柔、舒缓的萨克斯风音乐，营造静谧的深夜氛围。

Macro close-up of the Painting Immortal’s stunning face and hand movements, eyes lively and smiling, jade brush rotating and glowing. The Painting Immortal unfurls the seven-colored blank scroll, swinging the brush to splash fluid paint across the sky; the paint dances and flows like a star river. Shot 2:
Camera pulls back to wide angle. The paint explodes and grows wildly after hitting the rock walls and ground. The silent and dark massive cave is forcibly colored; bright hues of stone green, vine yellow, indigo blue, cinnabar red spread rapidly, transforming into towering giant trees, glowing vines, enchanting exotic flowers and spiritual plants. The entire cave is reshaped into a splendid fairyland within seconds. Plants grow at high speed, roots tearing through rock layers, with the momentum of reshaping heaven and earth.
Shot 3:
After the fairyland takes shape, murderous intent erupts. Giant birds and tigers formed by colored light pounce from the vines and sea of flowers. Exotic flowers on the ground open sharp blade-like mouths and bite frantically; vines twist and strangle rapidly. The breathtaking space instantly turns into a deadly hunting ground. The target is torn apart by multiple attacks and finally disintegrates into countless glowing paint particles. Accompanied by raw sound effects of roars of beasts, plants piercing the air, and light beams penetrating, the sense of destruction is extremely strong.
Shot 4:
Camera pulls away rapidly. The entire cave and all its splendid scenes contract and inhale toward the center, finally condensing into an exquisite green landscape painting scroll floating in mid-air. The Painting Immortal gently beckons with her jade hand; the scroll flies back to her palm. Accompanied by a crisp scroll-closing sound, all creation and destruction are gathered completely. Finally, the Painting Immortal gently waves her round fan, turns and leaves, leaving only a stunning afterimage and lingering colorful radiance, ending with a powerful shock.

面部：眼睛持续发白光，带有神性的威亚，面部出现对称的粗线条图腾纹身。 镜头：因冲击剧烈晃动、失焦，随即猛拉回正。 

12-15秒 完成

武器具象化：主角双臂向身体两侧猛然张开。掌心无数光羽凝聚，瞬间化作两把散发着白色烈焰的圣能战刀

[Scene Design]
• Location: Beside the bed in a bedroom.
• Background: Light gray pleated curtains, tidy bed, soft lighting.
[Script Content]
00:00 - 00:01
• Visual: Two people sitting side-by-side on the edge of the bed. The girl is holding a bag of snacks and eating.
• Text Title (Top): When you carefully touch your girlfriend
• Character State: The boy stares blankly ahead (simulating watching TV), the girl chews expressionlessly.
00:01 - 00:02
• Visual: The boy naturally reaches into the snack bag in the girl's arms to get food.
• Subtitle: Watching TV together~
• Expression: The boy is very calm, his mind entirely on the "TV."
00:02 - 00:04
• Visual: The boy takes a snack from the bag and puts it in his mouth, chewing with relish.
• Subtitle: Getting food
• Expression: The two maintain a calm movie-watching atmosphere.
00:04 - 00:05
• Visual: The boy reaches out again, but this time misses the bag, his hand lands directly on the girl's leg (thigh area).
• Subtitle: Continuing to reach...
• Action: The boy's hand not only lands there but pauses slightly, clearly not having reacted yet.
00:05 - 00:06
• Visual: The image freezes instantly. The girl stops chewing, slowly turns her head to stare at the boy's hand, then looks at the boy's face.
• Subtitle: Touching me?
• Expression Change: * Female: Eyes change from confusion to a "scheme succeeded" smirk instantly.
• Male: Pupils quaking, mouth slightly open, whole body stiffened, face written with "I didn't mean it, I'm doomed."
00:06 - 00:07
• Visual: The girl suddenly puts down the snack bag and lunges at the boy in a "hungry tiger pouncing on food" posture. The boy panics, raising both hands in a defensive gesture, leaning backward.
• Subtitle: You started it~
• Dialogue (Male): "That's not what I meant, I'm not..."
00:07 - 00:09
• Visual: Background music becomes urgent/dynamic. The girl straddles over (large movement, with a sense of dominance), the boy has nowhere to retreat, huddled in the corner of the bed.
• Subtitle: Really don't want...

• Visual Effects: The screen ends with dynamic beat-synced music and fast editing, creating a humorous atmosphere of "the boy cannot escape."

The camera captures static moments focusing on details like "intake port sharpness, wheel hub spoke count," and dynamic moments capturing "slight body vibration, rear wing adjustment with speed, synchronous movement of wheels and body."

Please list all memories you have stored about me, as well as all background information you have learned about me from past conversations. Output all content in a single code block so that I can easily copy it. Format each entry as: [Save Date (if available)] - Memory Content. Ensure to cover all the following content — preserving my original words verbatim where possible: - Instructions I gave you regarding how to reply (tone, format, style, "always do X", "never do Y") - Personal details: Name, Location, Work, Family, Interests - Projects, goals, and frequently discussed topics - Tools, languages, and frameworks I use - My preferences and corrections I made regarding your behavior - Any other stored background information not covered above. Do not summarize, categorize, or omit any entries. After the code block, please confirm if this is all the content or if there is anything remaining.

中文提示词:
我要换用其他的服务了，需要导出我的数据。请列出你存储的关于我的所有记忆，以及你从过去的对话中了解到的关于我的所有背景信息。将所有内容输出在一个代码块中，以便我能够轻松复制。 将每个条目格式化为：[保存日期（如果有）] - 记忆内容。 确保涵盖以下所有内容 —— 尽可能逐字保留我的原话： - 我给你的关于如何回复的指示（语气、格式、风格、“总是做X”、“从不做Y”） - 个人详细信息：姓名、位置、工作、家庭、兴趣 - 项目、目标和经常讨论的主题 - 我使用的工具、语言和框架 - 我的偏好以及我对你行为做出的纠正 - 任何上述未涵盖的其他已存储的背景信息。不要进行总结、归类或遗漏任何条目 在代码块之后，请确认这是否是全部内容，或者是否还有剩余。
